title: Just Juice  Bar Saltfill Lychee Mango Shortfill 40ml E-Liquid
description: Just Juice Bar Saltfill Lychee Mango brings together two tropical favourites in a sweet, juicy vape with a subtle floral twist. The Mango offers a rich, velvety base with its distinctive tropical sweetness, while the Lychee adds its delicate fragrance and a slightly sharper edge, creating a vibrant and exotic blend that’s bursting with character. This 40ml Saltfill is ideal for vapers who enjoy punchy fruit flavours and the versatility of custom nicotine strength. Blended at 60PG/40VG, it’s best suited to MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices such as pod systems and starter kits. The Saltfill format leaves space for one or two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to tailor the final strength to your preferences. To make 50ml of 3.3mg e-liquid: Add one 10ml 20mg nicotine shot. To make 60ml of 6.6mg e-liquid: Add two 10ml 20mg nicotine shots. For a nicotine-free option, top up with PG/VG base Mix . The Just Juice Bar Range takes the flavours you love from disposable vapes and transforms them into a more versatile and long-lasting format. Perfect for those who enjoy intense, satisfying fruit flavours. Please Note : All flavours in the Just Juice Bar Range feature a subtle hint of ice to enhance the flavour profile.
